body:
## Motivation

Speculative decoding can commit a multi-token accept run that both contains a stop token / stop string and crosses `max_new_tokens` in the same step. The length-first ordering in `Req.update_finish_state` finished such steps as `FINISH_LENGTH` with `finished_len == max_new_tokens`, so tokens over-accepted after the stop (e.g. the bonus token sampled after an accepted EOS draft — the target's post-EOS prediction is degenerate) leaked into the emitted output as `[..., <eos>, <junk>]`.

## Modifications

- Reorder the checks in `Req.update_finish_state` so the stop-string / stop-token (EOS) checks run before the `max_new_tokens` length check: a stop matched within the length budget wins and trims at the stop.
- Add `Req._cap_finished_len_at_max_new_tokens`: a stop matched *beyond* the budget is demoted to a length finish at the cap, so the emitted output never exceeds `max_new_tokens`.
- Make vocabulary-boundary sanitization safe for prefill-only embedding and scoring requests, where `Req.vocab_size` is `None`; negative token IDs remain rejected, while the upper-bound check runs only when the vocabulary size is known.
- Add pure-CPU regression tests (`test/registered/unit/managers/test_finish_length_speculative.py`) driving the real `Req.update_finish_state`, including a replay of the production incident where an accept run ends `[..., <eot>, <junk>]` while crossing the cap.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable (no change to model forward / logits). Finish-state behavior is covered by the unit tests below:

- New: `test/registered/unit/managers/test_finish_length_speculative.py` — 9 passed.
- Existing tests covering `Req.update_finish_state` / `output_ids_through_stop` (`test_grammar_stop_speculative.py`, `test_stop_str_speculative.py`, `test_batch_result_processor_hidden_states.py`, `test_output_streamer_customized_info.py`) — 14 passed, 2 subtests passed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: the reordering moves the length comparison after the stop checks on the same per-step path; no new work is added.

## Original commits

- `0baeaa6b8`
